data.name: Damurah
data.gender_notes: Damurah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘damirah’, which means a steadfast mountain. This name reflects the unwavering nature of a person who remains strong and unyielding in their beliefs and values, even in the face of adversity. In Islamic tradition, mountains are symbolic of stability, resilience, and strength. The name Damurah carries the meaning “Steadfast mountain” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Damurah usually hope their child will grow to embody steadfast mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing steadfastness and resilience in faith.
data.etymology: Damurah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Steadfast mountain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Damurah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

In Islamic teachings, faith and strength in Allah (God) are essential virtues. The name Damurah embodies this notion and serves as a reminder to stay strong and steadfast in our beliefs and in our relationship with Allah, despite any challenges we may encounter in life.
